description.zh: 通话ID。您可以在[SingleCallByVideo](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm)接口返回参数中获取CallId。
description.en: The call ID. Get the CallId from the return parameters of the [SingleCallByVideo](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm) API.

description.zh: 接收视频通话的手机号码。
description.en: The mobile phone number that receives video calls.
The media type. The value is fixed to **video**.

description.zh:
预留给调用方的ID，最终会通过回执消息将此ID带回给调用方。

字符串类型，长度限制为1~15个字符。
description.en:
The ID reserved for the caller. This ID is returned to the caller in the receipt message.

This is a string with a length limit of 1 to 15 characters.

descriptions.zh: 目前5G视频通话功能处于邀约制阶段，您需要联系运营经理为您开通此功能。
descriptions.en: The 5G video call feature is currently available by invitation only. Contact your operations manager to enable this feature.
